title: 'Kabushikigaisha Magi-Lumière 2nd Season' Unveils Additional Cast, Opening Theme, Second Promo
content: • The official website of the Kabushikigaisha Magi-Lumière 2nd Season ( Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc. Season 2 ) television anime unveiled a pair of additional cast, the opening theme, and a second promotional video on Thursday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: MAO Anime Announces 2nd Part Opening Song by Boy Group 20th Century
content: The second cours of the MAO anime will start with its 14th episode on July 4. The anime debuted on April 4 on the NHK -General channel on April 4 at 11:45 p.m. (10:45 a.m. EST) and will run for two continuous cours without breaks.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Plans to Expand to Taiwan, S. Korea
content: Entertainment news website Deadline reported on Tuesday that Crunchyroll plans to expand to Taiwan and South Korea, with localization slated to begin in Taiwan this summer, and in South Korea later in the year. Crunchyroll president Rahul Purini made the announcement during the APOS conference in Bali, Indonesia.
author: ANN

title: 'Majutsu wo Kiwamete Tabi ni Deta Tensei Elf, Moteamashita Jumyou de Ikeru Densetsu to Naru' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo, 2027 Debut
content: Production company Asmik Ace opened an official site for the television anime adaptation of Monsho Sasakibara 's Majutsu wo Kiwamete Tabi ni Deta Tensei Elf, Moteamashita Jumyou de Ikeru Densetsu to Naru ( The Reincarnated Elf Left on a Journey to Master His Magic and With His Extra Lifespan Became a Living Legend )…
author: MyAnimeList

title: 2nd Live-Action Mr. Osomatsu Film Debuts at #3, New Version of Milky☆Subway Film at #9 in Japan
content: The second film in the series of live-action Mr. Osomatsu ( Osomatsu-san ) films opened in Japan at #3. The film sold 141,000 tickets and earned 218,240,200 yen (about US$1.35 million) in its first three days. Ae! Group also performs the film's theme song "Dekoboko Life" (Rough Life).
author: ANN

title: The World's Strongest Rearguard - Labyrinth Country's Novice Seeker Anime's 2nd Promo Video Reveals Theme Songs
content: The official website for the television anime of Tōwa 's The World's Strongest Rearguard - Labyrinth Country's Novice Seeker ( Sekai Saikyō no Kōei: Meikyūkoku no Shinjin Tansakusha ) light novel series started streaming the anime's second promotional video on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo Anime's Video Reveals Cast
content: The official website for the television anime of Shun Numa 's Super Psychic Policeman Chojo ( Chōjun! Chōjō Senpai ) manga unveiled a new promotional video and visual for the anime on Thursday. The video reveals the anime's cast.
author: ANN

title: SUNRISE and SHAFT Announce First-Ever Joint Anime Project, Reveal Teaser
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks has announced a brand-new anime project that will bring together two major studios for the first time. SUNRISE Studios and SHAFT are collaborating on an original animation project, with further details scheduled to be revealed on June 23.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ojisan wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki. Anime's Video Reveals Cast, Staff, October TV Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Tsutomu's Ojisan wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki. (Older Men Like Cute Things) manga began streaming the anime's first promotional video on Thursday. The video reveals the anime's cast, staff, and October television debut.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Nisemono no Renkinjutsushi' Receives TV Anime Adaptation
content: Production company Kadokawa opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Jirou Sugiura and Umemaru 's Nisemono no Renkinjutsushi ( The Fake Alchemist ) manga on Thursday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured), an announcement promo and Passione as the animation studio.
author: MyAnimeList
